import importlib.util, json, random, time
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('m', '/workspace/submission/main.py')
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(m)
rounds = []
orig = m.moore
def patched(n, trans, part, blocks):
    p = part; b = blocks; r = 0
    while True:
        r += 1
        getter = p.__getitem__; marks={}; newp=[0]*n; c=0
        for q in range(n):
            sig=(p[q],)+tuple(map(getter,trans[q]))
            i=marks.get(sig)
            if i is None: i=c;c+=1;marks[sig]=i
            newp[q]=i
        if c==b or c==n: break
        p,b=newp,c
        if r > 500: break
    rounds.append((r, n, b))
    return orig(n, trans, part, blocks)
m.moore = patched

rnd = random.Random(int(1))
worst = (0,0,0)
for trial in range(500):
    sigma = rnd.randint(1,5)
    toks = ['s%d'%i for i in range(sigma)]
    pool=[]
    for op in ('match','startswith','endswith','contains'):
        for _ in range(3):
            L = rnd.randint(0, min(8, sigma*4))
            pool.append({'op':op,'path':[rnd.choice(toks) for _ in range(L)]})
    rules=[]
    for _ in range(rnd.randint(1,3)):
        k = rnd.randint(1,4)
        rules.append({'action':rnd.choice(['allow','allow','drop']),
                      'when':{'op':rnd.choice(['and','or','not'] if k==1 else ['and','or']),
                              'args':[rnd.choice(pool) for _ in range(k)]} if k>1 else
                            {'op':'not','arg':rnd.choice(pool)}})
    req={'services':toks,'rules':rules,'queries':[]}
    del rounds[:]
    try:
        info = m.validate(json.loads(json.dumps(req)))
        m.compile_request(info)
    except (m.ComplexErr, m.LimitErr, m.SchemaErr):
        continue
    for r,n,b in rounds:
        if r > worst[0]: worst = (r,n,b)
print('max moore rounds after distance seeding over 500 random cases:', worst)
PYEOF
